What's different on Global

How Global differs from the Asian release, by topic: access, classes, content, gear, character growth and the economy.

7 min readUpdated Oct 1, 2026
Key points
  • Access: PC only, and Korea and Taiwan can't play.12
  • Classes: eight (no Brawler), with the Asian release's current skill kits; Stigmas cap at 20 with four slots, and the level cap is 45Datamine.345
  • Content: three launch maps (Verteron, Altgard, Lower Reshanta), six expeditions without Hard mode or the Ordeal, and Ludra as the only raidDatamine.678
  • Gear: Unique is the top grade (item level up to 102), enhancement stops at Rare +5, Epic +10 and Unique +15, and wings drop sealed from ConquestDatamine.91011
  • Growth is slower and smaller: smaller Daevanion boards, Pantheon stats halved, fewer skill points, pets capped at level 3Datamine.12131415
  • Economy: a $14.99 membership to buy on the Market (which opens at level 45), and no direct player-to-player tradingNC written.161718
Watch out

Don't spend scarce materials on an Asian-release stat priority or "best in slot" list on day one. Global characters have less total stat (halved Pantheon, weaker boards and titles, smaller enhancement bonuses), so the stat weights behind those lists don't carry over.131219

What carries over from the Asian release?

Mechanics, formulas, class kits and dungeon strategy carry over; item levels, rewards, growth numbers and the economy are Global's own.203

Is Global slower?

Yes. NC gave slowing progression as the reason for holding back Heroic gearNC on stream, and the launch client points the same way: smaller stat sources, fewer quest teleports, lower drop ratesDatamine.212223

Character growth â

Can I trade with other players?

Not directlyNC written. The Market is the route; it opens at level 45 and buying needs a membership.1718

Economy and trading â

Why do some guides quote numbers 100 times bigger?

Asian-release guides use two scales: Combat Power, which runs to hundreds of thousands, and item level, which runs to thousands. A number 100 times off is on the other scale.24

How far can I enhance?

Rare +5, Epic +10, Unique +15; there's no Heroic, Mythic or Pendant gearDatamine.109

Access and servers

Servers, factions, platforms and the rest of the launch facts: Launch dates, packs and servers.

On Global
PlatformPC only; the Asian release also runs on mobileNC written1
Who can play18 countries excluded, including Korea and TaiwanNC written2
Languages8, no ChineseNC written25
RegionsFive: North America East and West, Europe, South America and Asia (Tokyo, the one NC calls Japan)Datamine. Not region-locked: pick anyNC on stream, but a character can't move to another region laterDatamine226
Character slots4, expandable to 8, against 5 open on the Asian releaseNC on streamDatamine227
RulesGlobal has its own operation policy and Code of Conduct, from 17 September 2026: Rules and policiesNC written28

Classes and combat

On Global
ClassesEight. Brawler can't be createdDatamine2930
Class balanceThe Asian release's kits after its 16 September patch; only two 23 September changes (Robe of Cold's snare, Gladiator rush steering) aren't inDatamine331
StigmasLevel cap 20 (Asian release 25); four slots, opening at levels 22, 27, 32 and 37; 13 Stigmas per classDatamine4
Skill and Stigma points203 skill points and 29 Stigma points by level 45, against 231 and 23Datamine14
Crit and evasion capsThe stat tooltips say Crit 50% and Evasion 30%, against 80% and 50%Datamine32
Front/Back Damage BoostPresent, on Genus boards2 players33
Boss telegraphsFloor attacks land with their animation: 24 frames from telegraph to hit, against 8One source34
In-game macroPresent, with the same delay range (10â9,900 ms); the gamepad has no default Macro bindingDatamine35

Levels and content

On Global
Level cap45; Conquest and all PvP unlock thereNC on streamDatamine36527
WorldThree maps: Verteron, Altgard and Chaotic Lower Reshanta. Eltnen and Morheim content needs level 46, so it's closed at launchDatamine637
LevellingQuest objectives almost never teleport you (43 against 583), and the Verteron and Altgard story asks for about 1.9 times the killsDatamine22
UnlocksMarket at level 45 (Asian release 16), Gathering at 10 (45)Datamine38
ExpeditionsSix: Krao Cave, Urugugu Canyon, Fire Temple, Draupnir, Vakron Sky Island and Ferocious Horn Den. No Hard mode, no OrdealDatamine78
Expedition gatesItem level 700 / 1,400 / 2,100, against 1,000 / 1,600 / 2,200Datamine39
TranscendenceGates 1,600 / 1,900 / 2,200 / 2,500, against 1,200 to 2,200, with higher-level bossesDatamine40
LudraThe only raid: item level 2,800, 1 rewarded kill a week as on the Asian release, but at 40 Odyle Energy against 80Datamine414243
NightmareZikel's Apparition has 10 stages (2,400 â 3,000), cleared in orderDatamine44
Ascension TrialFour difficulties, up to ChallengeDatamine45
ResetsDailies, check-in and the daily Kina cap reset at 07:00 UTC, one moment on every region (16:00 Korea time: midnight Pacific, 9 AM in Central Europe)Seen in gameSeen on stream, weekly counters on Wednesday at that momentDatamine, against 05:00 server time on the Asian releaseDatamine. Scheduled events (Rifts, the Abyss) run on each region's own clock insteadSeen on stream. The client gives each region its own time zone: New York (NA East), Los Angeles (NA West), Berlin (Europe), SÃ£o Paulo (South America), Seoul (Asia)Datamine46474826
Group sizesExpeditions up to 5NC written; the Ludra raid 10NC on stream49
Dungeon matchingCross-server and cross-faction within a region, with a "my faction only" optionNC on stream2
PvP10v10 Arena of Tactics with equalised gear and skills; ranked 1v1 and 5v5 arenasNC on streamDatamine. The Abyss is Lower Reshanta only, and there's no Spacetime Rift DominationDatamine49505152
CustomizationThe styling tab is "Face Art / Scar", with a Tattoo Shape optionDatamine53
Faction chatOpens at level 30, against 45Datamine; gold sellers spammed it in the testTest players275417

Gear

On Global
Top gradeUnique. No Heroic or Mythic equipment; item levels run 36 to 102, and Ludra's weapons are Unique 102Datamine9
Slots20: no Pendant, Brooch or SealDatamine55
Enhancement capsRare +5, Epic +10, Unique +15, against +10 / +15 / +15; the odds are the Asian release's, and a failure never costs a levelDatamine10
What a + level addsScales with item level and is smaller: +15 on a Unique weapon adds 61 Attack at level 36 and 174 at 102, against a flat 225Datamine19
AmpStages depend on item level: none below 54, then 1, 3 and 5 stages; the stat is Damage Boost or Damage ToleranceDatamine56
PotentialA PvP line on almost every Unique piece: up to 2% PvP Damage Boost or ToleranceDatamine57
TransferUnique only, in three item-level tiers, paid with Transfer Stones; it always succeedsDatamine58
Crafted gearTops out at item level 102; proficiency caps at 100; no built-in PvE lineDatamine5960
WingsNo wing enhancement, but wings still give stats, apart from three appearance-only onesDatamine61. Expedition wings come sealed from Conquest: 0.75% per final-boss reward, 0.25% per mid-boss rewardDatamine6211
Arcana5 card types and 2 sets; a levelled card fed to another returns all its EXPDatamine63
Manastones, proc stonesNC's tutorial moved their sources to endgame content: Transcendence, Sanctuary and the AbyssNC tutorial64
DropsField drops are lower: refining stones about a quarter, Unique field gear about a quarterDatamine23

Character growth

On Global
Daevanion boardsFive (Nezekan, Zikel, Vaizel, Triniel, Azphel), no Ariel. Nezekan, Zikel and Vaizel cost 134 each (Asian release 210), Triniel 168; stat nodes weaker, skill nodes unchangedDatamine12
Daevanion currencyCalled Daevanion CrystalDatamine53
Pantheon statsHalved for all ten: 0.1% per point instead of 0.2%Datamine13
TitlesHalf are hidden and most shown titles are weaker; none gives SmiteDatamine65
Pets207; level cap 3; Natura pets give Stamina instead of MPDatamine6615
Pet GenusCheaper (Analyze 4 crystals, Insight 1 â 10 in 250,000); Smite only on the Special board's fourth slotDatamine6768
Wisdom StonesNo longer from the Monolith; regional quests pay 58 per character, and each of your own region's 61 sealed dungeons pays 2, with 2 Daevanion CrystalsDatamine6970

Economy and trading

Membership in full: Membership and the shop.

On Global
Player trading"Direct player-to-player trades are disabled" as an anti-bot measureNC written; the membership has no personal-trade perkDatamine7172
MembershipOne Special Quai Membership, $14.99 per 30 days, per serverNC written. Perks: Remote Storage, Market buying, Quna Exchange, Wind Breeze Merchants, two Odyle infusions per cube, higher Odyle and Shugo key caps; no extra Abyss timeDatamine167372
MarketOpens at level 45; buying needs a membership; fewer items are tradeableDatamine18
Currency exchangeKina for Quna, traded between players; needs a membershipNC written17
Odyle Energy15 per 3 hours for everyone; cap 560, or 840 with the membershipDatamine74
Shugo Festa keys+3 a day, cap 12, or 21 with the membershipDatamine74
Wind Breeze MerchantsMembers only: Soul Crystals at 500 Kina, Odyle Energy, daily-dungeon instant clears, potions at half priceDatamine75
Abyss ShopSells skins rather than gear, plus tiered growth itemsDatamine7677
Shop and packsShop cosmetics give "no gameplay or combat advantage"; Founder's Pack cosmetics are "appearance-only"NC written73
Battle passPer character; the paid track includes upgrade materialsNC written73
Trust indicatorAn icon beside your Kina shows a trust level3 players17
